recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The seed is fully reconciled in current core; future detailed NDC usage changes should be made in HL7 Terminology rather than by recreating the removed FHIR-core ndc.html page.
issue_request: FHIR-8046 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Pharmacy change request asking for a system URI for NDC (National Drug Code) in the Medication area; Jira comments identify it as a duplicate of FHIR-7524 and record SVN revision 5652.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 069fdd9067719c775cffbacc867421bad8739bbd applied the issue family with subject '#8046 / #7524 - define NDC usage', adding source/ndc.html and the NDC row in source/terminologies-systems.html.
additional_context: FHIR-7524 is the direct duplicate target and names http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ndc for OID 2.16.840.1.113883.6.69. Later FHIR-35933 intentionally moved external-code-system usage pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology and retargeted the NDC guidance link to terminology.hl7.org/NDC.html.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/terminologies-systems.html lists http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ndc, NDC/NHRIC Codes, the HL7 Terminology NDC guidance link, and OID 2.16.840.1.113883.6.69; the page is referenced by active terminology module navigation.
